maria-ops: Hey team — onboarding a new enterprise tenant in me-south-1 (Bahrain). They need low-latency inference near customers and asked for dedicated p5 capacity. Can we request GPU quotas?

alex-infra: Copy. What families + counts are we asking for? Also need ENI / IP / EBS IOPS limits checked for p5.

maria-ops: Requesting: p5 (reserved for inference) = 8 instances, p4d.24xlarge = 2 (for occasional fine-tuning), g5.12xlarge = 6 (fallback). Also increase Elastic IPs for NATs by 4 and ENI quota bump to support 32 ENIs in the account. Business justification: enterprise contract requires 200 concurrent low-latency connections; p5s for steady serving, p4d for model updates.

alex-infra: Sounds reasonable. Can you paste the customer account id and expected sustained vCPU/GPU hours per month? AWS likes utilization numbers.

maria-ops: Account: 987654321098. Estimated steady-state: 8 p5s * 24 * 30 = ~5760 GPU-hours/month. Spikes: +40% during peak. Cost estimate ~ $200k/mo on-demand, we'll convert to reserved if they sign.

jordan-ml: Quick question — do we need Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) enabled for p5s in that region? Customer said some distributed inference pipelines will use NCCL. If so we should request EFA quotas and check AMI compatibility.

sam-cloudeng: I'll open the service-quotas request. We should ask for these quotas in one case: EC2 On-Demand (p5 family) = 12 -> 24, EC2 On-Demand (p4d) = 2 -> 6, EC2 On-Demand (g5) = 6 -> 12, Network interfaces (account) -> 32 -> 128, EFA-enabled instance quota -> enable for p5/g5 families, Elastic IPs -> +4. Will also request elevated ENI/IPs per subnet if needed.

quota-bot: Created AWS Service Quota request SQ-20260305001 for ec2-p5-instances in me-south-1. Current status: PENDING. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home?region=me-south-1#/requests/SQ-20260305001

aws-support-bot: Case 1234567890 opened with AWS Support for increase of p4d/p5/g5 quotas and ENI limits. Please add justification docs at: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home#/case/?caseId=1234567890

alex-infra: Great. Two action items: (1) maria, drop a short one-pager for AWS with the performance justification + expected monthly spend, (2) sam, flag EFA dependencies and double-check which AMIs and kernel drivers we need in me-south-1.

maria-ops: Will do — uploading the one-pager to the case now. FYI cost/justification doc link: https://redwood.internal/docs/me-south1-gpu-justification.pdf

jordan-ml: If AWS pushes back on p5 availability in region we can fallback to g5 pool + cross-region routing. But prefer native p5 for latency SLA.

sam-cloudeng: Noted. I'll add a fallback routing policy in the deployment config and mock capacity tests once quotas land.

maria-ops: Thanks — keeping this thread for updates from quota-bot / aws-support-bot. I'll post when case changes. :thumbsup:
